definition: a device that rings to wake you up
description: In a small bedroom in bright morning light, a young woman with messy blonde hair and a white T-shirt lies asleep on a white pillow. Beside the bed a round silver alarm clock with two bells stands on a wooden chair used as a bedside table, on a newspaper next to a book and a glass of water. She lifts her head, sits up half-asleep and swings her arm down towards the clock, knocking the book off, then drops back onto the pillow and sleeps again. A chest of drawers and a window with thin curtains are behind her.
